page_title: REI 4-2 MNT | Reims v Montpellier 06/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Benoit Bastien has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' Montpellier have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' 4 - 2 Goal! Teddy Teuma (Reims) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Dimitry Bertaud to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
90+3' Teddy Teuma (Reims) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.

90+3' Handball! A player from Montpellier handled the ball. PENALTY to Reims! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
90+1' 3 - 2 Goal! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top left corner. He makes it 3:2.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
89' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
87' Ball possession – 46:54.
84' The referee allows time for a substitution. Marshall Munetsi will be replaced by Abdoul Kone (Reims).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) is replacing Junya Ito.
83' Mohamed Daramy (Reims) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Keito Nakamura.
82' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to substitute Lucas Mincarelli and he is replaced by Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier).
80' Axel Gueguin (Montpellier) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
79' Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
77' Emmanuel Agbadou (Reims) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
74' Here's the change. Oumar Diakite leaves the pitch and Amine Salama (Reims) comes on as a substitute.
74' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Enzo Tchato (Montpellier) replacing Stefan Dzodic.
73' Benoit Bastien shows a yellow card to Teddy Teuma (Reims) for his blatant foul.
71' The referee awards a corner and Teddy Teuma (Reims) goes over to take it.
68' It's time for a substitution. Gabriel Bares (Montpellier) comes on in place of Birama Toure.
68' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Wahbi Khazri is replaced by Axel Gueguin (Montpellier).
67' Junya Ito (Reims) sends a cross into the box, but Dimitry Bertaud comes off his line to gather the ball.
64' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yaya-Kader Fofana trots off the pitch and is replaced by Teddy Teuma (Reims).
60' It will be a corner kick for Montpellier.
59' Oumar Diakite (Reims) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
58' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
57' 3 - 1 Oumar Diakite (Reims) leaps to meet a beautiful cross and pings a header past the goalkeeper low into the middle of the net.
56' The ball possession at the moment is 43:57.
53' Oumar Diakite (Reims) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
52' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
51' Some great controlled play and passing from Reims. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
49' Stefan Dzodic (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
48' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Dimitry Bertaud comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' Referee Benoit Bastien blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Close! Wahbi Khazri (Montpellier) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' Junya Ito (Reims) trips an opposition player and Benoit Bastien signals a foul.
42' Reims are ruled offside.
39' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Junya Ito (Reims), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
37' Akor Adams (Montpellier) is given a fully deserved yellow card.

37' 2 - 1 Brilliant finish! Arnaud Nordin (Montpellier) perfectly collected a pass on the edge of the penalty area from Wahbi Khazri, then produced a nice strike into the right side of the goal. The score is 2:1.
36' What a beautiful long-range strike by Teji Savanier (Montpellier). He is quite unlucky as his shot flies just over the bar.
35' A cross from Keito Nakamura (Reims) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
32' A player from Reims commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
30' 8:2 – the total goal attempt statistics.
28' A terrific attempt by Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Birama Toure (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Benoit Bastien didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

25' 2 - 0 Goal! Keito Nakamura (Reims) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Dimitry Bertaud had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:0.
23' Keito Nakamura (Reims) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
21' Keito Nakamura (Reims) is about to take a corner kick.
19' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) is penalised for holding. Benoit Bastien signals a set piece.
17' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
17' Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
14' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 45:55.
11' Yaya-Kader Fofana (Reims) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
8' Montpellier keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
6' 1 - 0 Oumar Diakite showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Marshall Munetsi (Reims) gets onto the scoresheet by heading inside the left post. It's 1:0.
5' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) makes a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Birama Toure (Montpellier) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Montpellier will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will officiate today.
